outcome: Postnatal causes of persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN)
cohort: 122 newborns with confirmed PPHN and a gestational age above 34 weeks
finding: The most common postnatal causes of PPHN were meconium aspiration syndrome, birth asphyxia, and respiratory distress syndrome, and severe PPHN was the most frequent form.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery for 70 (57.4%) of the newborns with PPHN.
